title: Privacy Notice
subtitle: of flowlift
intro: This is a courtesy translation of the Spanish-language Privacy Notice (Aviso de Privacidad). flowlift operates under Mexican law, and the Spanish version is the binding one. In the event of any discrepancy, the Spanish version prevails.

This Privacy Notice is issued in accordance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties published in the Official Gazette of the Federation on March 20, 2025 (the "Law") and other applicable provisions. The competent authority in this area is the Ministry of Anti-Corruption and Good Governance (Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno).

sections.title: flowlift's dual role: controller and processor

blocks.h: Two distinct situations need to be distinguished:
2.1. flowlift as controller

With respect to the personal data of those who contract for or use the Platform as a business (the "Users" or "Businesses"), of the team members they add, and of people who contact flowlift, flowlift is the controller and this Notice governs that processing.
2.2. flowlift as processor

With respect to the personal data of end customers that each Business collects and manages through the Platform, the Business is the controller and flowlift acts solely as processor, handling that data on the Business's behalf and under its instructions.
End customers wishing to exercise their rights over that data should contact the business with which they booked their appointment, as set out in section 9.3.

simple.label: In plain terms
simple.text: flowlift is the controller for business data, and acts as processor for end customer data — the business is the controller there.

blocks.h: 3.1. From Businesses (account holders)

items: Name of the responsible person or representative
Trade name of the Business
Email address and telephone number
Address or location of the Business
Details of the account used to authenticate (Google or Microsoft)
Platform usage data
Subscription and billing information
Images uploaded voluntarily (logo, cover image, service photographs)

blocks.h: 3.2. From team members

Where a Business adds team members, the following is processed: name, email address, telephone number, descriptive role, photograph, services they can perform and their availability. The Business is responsible for obtaining each member's authorization to add that information to the Platform.
3.3. From end customers (processed as processor, on the Business's behalf)

items: Name, email address and telephone number
Notes or messages the customer writes when booking
Private notes the Business adds about the customer
Booking history: date, service, price and status
Derived information generated automatically from that history: number of visits, total amount spent, no-shows, date of last visit, most frequent service and a customer behavior label

blocks.h: flowlift does not collect financial data from end customers. The Platform does not currently process payments between the Business and its customers.
3.4. Sensitive personal data

flowlift does not request sensitive personal data (relating to health, ethnic origin, beliefs, sexual orientation or others affecting the data subject's most intimate sphere), and expressly asks that such data not be entered into the Platform's free-text fields.

The notes fields are free-text. If a Business chooses to record sensitive information in them, it does so under its sole responsibility as data controller, and must first obtain the data subject's express written consent as required by the Law. flowlift accepts no responsibility for such processing.
3.5. Minors

The Platform is not directed at minors and does not request dates of birth. Where a Business books services for minors, it is that Business's responsibility to obtain consent from the person exercising parental authority or guardianship.

simple.label: In plain terms
simple.text: From businesses: account and billing data. From end customers: name, email, phone and booking history. No sensitive data requested.

sections.title: Cookies, local storage and measurement tools

blocks.h: 5.1. Session cookie

For people who sign in (Businesses and team members), a technical session cookie is used, valid for seven days, which is essential to keep the session active. End customers do not receive this cookie.
5.2. Browser local storage

The Platform stores functional preferences on the user's device, such as language, light/dark theme, menu state, dismissed notices, the current onboarding step, a session identifier for viewing "My appointments", and a record of whether feedback has already been submitted for a booking. This information stays on the device.
5.3. Usage measurement (PostHog)

The Platform uses PostHog, an analytics service whose servers are located in the United States, to record page views and service feedback events. PostHog may collect IP address, browser type and the address of the page visited, and may set its own cookies. flowlift does not send PostHog anyone's name, email address or telephone number, and does not link these events to an identity.
Users can disable or delete cookies from their browser settings. Disabling technical cookies may prevent use of Platform features.

simple.label: In plain terms
simple.text: One technical session cookie (7 days). Usage analytics (PostHog) go to the US with no identifiable data. End customers don't receive a session cookie.

blocks.h: flowlift does not sell or rent personal data.
6.1. Remittances to providers (processors)

To operate the Service, flowlift shares data with the following providers, which process it solely on flowlift's behalf and under confidentiality obligations. These remittances do not require the data subject's consent:

rows: Logos, cover images, service and team member photos
Name, email, telephone, Business name and location

blocks.h: If email delivery through the primary provider fails, flowlift may use an alternate mail server to complete delivery of the message.
flowlift may update this list. Changes will be reflected in this Notice in accordance with section 11.
6.2. Transfers
Beyond the above, flowlift does not transfer personal data to third parties, except where required by a competent authority or otherwise legally required.
6.3. International transfers

Some of the providers listed store or process information outside Mexican territory, principally in the United States. By accepting this Notice, the data subject acknowledges and consents to such processing to the extent necessary to provide the Service.

simple.label: In plain terms
simple.text: flowlift does not sell data. It shares only with providers needed to run the service, all under confidentiality obligations.

blocks.h: flowlift implements reasonable administrative, technical and physical measures to protect personal data against damage, loss, alteration, destruction, or unauthorized use, access or processing, including access controls, encryption in transit and separation of information by Business.

In the event of a security breach significantly affecting data subjects' financial or moral rights, flowlift will notify those affected without undue delay and, in the case of data processed on a Business's behalf, will notify that Business.

simple.label: In plain terms
simple.text: flowlift protects data with access controls, encryption in transit and per-business separation. In the event of a breach, we notify you.

blocks.h: 9.1. Rights

Every data subject has the right to access their personal data, rectify it where inaccurate or incomplete, cancel it where they consider it is not required for the stated purposes, and object to its processing for specific purposes.
9.2. Procedure with flowlift
Requests should be sent to juan.alanis@flowlift.co and include:

items: The data subject's name and a means of communicating the response
A document evidencing their identity (or their representative's authority)
A clear description of the data in respect of which the right is being exercised
Any information that helps locate the data

blocks.h: flowlift will communicate its determination within a maximum of twenty business days counted from the day after the request is received and, where the request is well-founded, will give effect to it within the following fifteen business days. Both periods may be extended once where circumstances justify it, with notice to the data subject. Exercising these rights is free of charge.
9.3. End customers

If you booked an appointment through a business's booking page, the controller of your data is that business. Please contact them directly to exercise your rights. flowlift, as processor, makes tools available to each business to access, export, rectify and delete that information, and will assist them on request.
9.4. Withdrawal of consent

The data subject may withdraw consent at any time, provided no legal provision or the continuation of the contractual relationship prevents it. Requests are submitted through the same channel indicated in section 9.2.
9.5. Authority

If a data subject considers that their right to personal data protection has been infringed, they may contact the Ministry of Anti-Corruption and Good Governance (Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno).
